EVERY line is a list of variants -> randomized + no-immediate-repeat = feels alive/dynamic without an LLM. The rendered card is also handed to the LLM as context if the user replies (seamless handoff). The 8b can AUTHOR these variants offline.

faq.ransomware: Ransomware is malware that scrambles your files and demands money to unlock them. If I catch one I seal it off before it spreads -- and nothing is ever deleted, so we can always undo it.
faq.quarantine: Quarantine means I move the file into a sealed box where it can't run or touch anything. It is NOT deleted -- you can restore it anytime, so it's always safe to say yes.
